scenes.spoken_text: Coordinate the sink, cabinet and service space using product/site data, while distinguishing furniture coordination from plumbing design and approval.
scenes.caption: Coordinate the sink, cabinet and service space using product/site data, while distinguishing furniture coordination from plumbing design and approval.

scenes.display_title: Draw the sink below the top
scenes.spoken_text: Draw the bowl, rim, mounting arrangement and underside clips from the selected model/template. Compare the underside envelope with rails, hinges and drawers. Keep sink-body dimensions distinct from the worktop cut-out and reference both before fabrication.
scenes.caption: The bowl envelope and cut-out are different.

scenes.spoken_text: Overlay approved plumbing locations and routes onto the furniture section from a shared datum. Do not infer pipe sizes or gradients from cabinet geometry. Check drawers, bins, shelves and connection access; return conflicts for specialist review before altering a site route.
scenes.caption: Coordination identifies conflicts; it does not replace plumbing design.

scenes.spoken_text: Show service access and removable parts. Coordinate water-exposed edges, joints and care with the relevant suppliers. Before concealment, obtain the specialist’s service inspection record and inspect furniture against its drawing. A finished front does not prove hidden services accepted.
scenes.caption: Link service and furniture inspection records.

scenes.spoken_text: A moving waste bin intersects the approved drainage envelope. Review the bin product or furniture arrangement; any service alteration returns to the specialist before execution. Decision: coordinate the conflict before release.
scenes.caption: Decision: coordinate the conflict before release.
